sloka: अभिवाद्य च धर्मात्मा रामो भ्राता च लक्ष्मणः ।सुग्रीवो वानराअः चैव जग्मुः संहृष्ट मानसाः ॥४-१३-२८॥
transliteration: abhivādya ca dharmātmā rāmo bhrātā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ।sugrīvo vānarāaḥ caiva jagmuḥ saṁhṛṣṭa mānasāḥ ॥4-13-28॥

translations.english: Righteous Rama, Lakshmana, Sugriva and all the monkeys offered obeisance and proceeded delighted at heart.
